Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported
at an intersection in Baytown. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give the facts, but I'm [claimant name withheld for the record]. Go ahead.
Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?
A: I was making a left turn at a green light. There was a gap in oncoming traffic, so I started through. The other
vehicle came from the opposite direction and hit the front passenger side of my car as I was crossing into the lane.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started your turn?
A: I saw headlights a ways back, but it looked far enough off that I figured I had time. I didn't account for how fast it
was coming.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?
A: Yes, the lap and shoulder belt.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: No. The car jolted hard and the seatbelt locked me in place. My head snapped forward and back.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lower back strain. I've been
doing physical therapy twice a week since then.
Q: Are you experiencing any symptoms right now?
A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially when I turn to check mirrors, and my lower back aches after sitting for more than
twenty minutes. Some mornings it's hard to get out of bed.
Q: Have you missed any work because of these symptoms?
A: I've taken a few partial days off for appointments. I work a desk job, so I'm managing for now, but it's
uncomfortable.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want the record to show I'm not trying to exaggerate anything. I'm simply trying to get better and get my
car repaired.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
